# Brain4Cars benchmarks

Results are comparable only within the same protocol section. A code link is not an independent reproduction.

## ICCV 2015 five-fold all-maneuver HMM cohort

<a id="brain4cars-iccv2015-all-maneuvers-cv"></a>

**Task:** `action_anticipation` (original: Maneuver anticipation)  
**Dataset release:** `v1` · **Annotation version:** `author-release-unspecified`  
**Target:** `future_maneuver` · **Split:** Author five-fold cross-validation over natural driving clips

### Comparison setting

| Dimension | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Sample selection | All-maneuver five-class cohort from the original study; 274 lane changes, 131 turns and 295 straight-driving events. This is not a driver-held-out or later-paper split. |
| Inputs | rgb, vehicle_telemetry; Context observed before maneuver onset; evaluation predicts one of four maneuvers or continuing straight every 0.8 seconds. |
| Representation | Driver-face features from in-cabin video plus lane, road-context, GPS/map and speed features from the road-facing stream. |
| Observation window | variable seconds (Recent sequential context is updated at every prediction step; Table I does not use one fixed observation length for all three HMM variants.) |
| Anticipation gap | variable seconds (Predictions may occur at different lead times; Table I reports mean time-to-maneuver separately rather than imposing a fixed gap.) |
| Prediction horizon | 5 seconds (each prediction step) |
| Training policy | external_data: allowed, pretraining: allowed, extra_supervision: allowed, ensemble: forbidden |
| Evaluation | Author Table I five-fold cross-validation, all-maneuver columns; prediction threshold selected for F1 on validation data.; Mean precision and recall across the five folds; parenthesized standard errors are preserved per score. |

### Metrics

| Metric | Definition | Direction | Unit | Subset | Evidence |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `precision` | Author-reported precision for anticipating all maneuver classes, averaged over five cross-validation folds. | higher | percent | all maneuvers | [original_paper](https://brain4cars.com/pdfs/brain4cars.pdf) |
| `recall` | Author-reported recall for anticipating all maneuver classes, averaged over five cross-validation folds. | higher | percent | all maneuvers | [original_paper](https://brain4cars.com/pdfs/brain4cars.pdf) |

### Best verified results found in recorded snapshots

**Best verified paper-reported result found — checked 2026-10-08.** Three matched inside-plus-outside HMM-family rows from the original paper's Table I. Later RNN papers and other input-feature cohorts are not included. Recall is tied between IOHMM and AIO-HMM at reported precision. Evidence: [original_paper](https://brain4cars.com/pdfs/brain4cars.pdf).
